$comment: Shared sample-screen manifest for the web search settings family (shots tool, external web search). One source for page names, demo connections, saved search services and per-page presets across iOS, Android debug and Web dev shot entries. Every end renders its production web search settings views from this file with in-memory data: no real store writes, no key reads, no network, no test search is sent (test outcomes come from `preset.test`). The catalog is each end's built-in snapshot (search_catalog_view.v1.json data). iOS is the gold reference; boards are the design boards for the web search screens.
$pages: services: all = every service above in order; none = empty list. preset.open names the screen on top of the list. test: outcome shown as already finished (searchTestPresentation input). Model-options pages (boards ⑥～⑩): preset.open = modelOptions | sourcePicker opens the chat Model Options sheet (or its Search via sheet) for preset.model = { name, connection (connection id), form, nativeWeb, toolCall } — the web card must come out of the production resolveWebSearchRoute → webSearchCardPresentation chain with these as inputs; webOn is the conversation web toggle; connections: none = no provider connections (default all); stored = the conversation's searchSourceStorageKey value before resolveSearchSource runs. Boards: OptExternal ⑥, OptPresearch ⑥ presearch, OptNotArmed = conversation web on from a native model, external not yet turned on for this model, OptReuse ⑦, OptNone ⑧, OptNative ⑨, OptFallback ⑨ + fallback notice, SourcePicker ⑩. Chat pages (boards ⑪～⑬): preset.open = chat shows one user message (userText) and one assistant reply for preset.model; the reply state must come from the production startSearchReply → applySearchEvent → finishSearchReply chain run over shared/search-contracts/search-turn.v1.json replyCases[preset.replyCase] (start + events, not copied values). phase = searching stops after the first send effect (activity line ⑪ with the query chip); phase = done runs every event and renders answer (model text with [n] marks) plus the sources card (sourcesExpanded) or error card. Boards: ChatSearching ⑪, ChatAnswer ⑫, ChatError ⑬ (insufficient balance: top up + switch), ChatErrorRateLimited / ChatErrorFormat / ChatErrorHostChanged / ChatErrorWithdrawn / ChatErrorNetwork = the other error-card layouts ⑬ (retry later / check settings + switch / reconfirm / switch service / retry), ChatReused = regenerate reused the previous search (⑬).
